fields.notes: AHB (IHI 0033C) and APB (IHI 0024C) are wire-level / cycle-level bus protocol specs. They define logical signal semantics and timing rules relative to HCLK / PCLK only - no PDK-specific SDC, no floorplan / placement constraints, no clock-tree budget. Per-implementation timing closure (clock period, max-skew, max-fanout, IO standards) is the responsibility of the SoC integrator and is captured outside these protocol specs.

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
